{{Color box|{{party color|Asenso Manileño}}|border=darkgray}} [[Asenso Manileño]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Manila's 4th congressional district''' is one of the six [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the city of [[Manila]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1949.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 20, 2020}} The district consists of [[barangay]]s 395 to 586 in the northern Manila district of [[Sampaloc, Manila|Sampaloc]] bordering [[Quezon City]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=April 10, 2020}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Giselle Lazaro-Maceda]] of the [[Nationalist People's Coalition]] and [[Asenso Manileño]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 20, 2020}} Previously from 1949 to 1972, the district encompassed the southern Manila districts of [[Ermita]], [[Intramuros]], [[Malate, Manila|Malate]], [[Paco, Manila|Paco]], [[Pandacan]], [[Port Area, Manila|Port Area]], and [[Santa Ana, Manila|Santa Ana]], which also includes the present-day [[San Andres, Manila|San Andres]]. The current configuration took effect after the restoration of the [[Congress of the Philippines|Congress]] in 1987, when the aforementioned districts were reapportioned to the new [[Manila's 5th congressional district|fifth]] and [[Manila's 6th congressional district|sixth]] districts, respectively, while the fourth district was reapportioned to encompass Sampaloc. ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
